text: Mix Vaseline with baking soda. Pharmacists do not want you to know this. Put in a bowl one teaspoon of Vaseline, one teaspoon of honey, half a teaspoon of baking soda, and one teaspoon of coconut oil. Mix everything for one minute until you get a smooth paste. Each of these ingredients has a purpose. Vaseline seals in moisture and protects the skin like a shield. Honey is antibacterial and has been used for centuries to heal wounds and nourish the skin from within. Baking soda gently exfoliates and removes the dead cells that are dulling your face, and coconut oil penetrates the skin and feeds it deeply. Together, they do what many $50 creams cannot. Apply it to your face and leave it for 15 minutes. You will feel a slight tingling. That is the baking soda working, then rinse with warm water never hot. Hot water opens the pores too much and dries the skin out. Do this twice a week, and within a few weeks you will notice the difference. Brighter skin, dark spots beginning to fade, impurities disappearing, and your face recovering a glow you have not seen in a long time. The most powerful remedies have always been the simplest. Nature has been offering you everything you need for thousands of years, but the industry convinced you it was not enough so they could sell you something more expensive. But I want you to understand something. Your skin is a reflection of what is happening inside of you. You can apply the best mask in the world. If on the inside you are living stressed, sleeping badly, and carrying emotions you never release, your face is going to show it. Dark circles, dull skin, premature aging, these are almost never a skin problem. They are a problem of how you live. Write in the comments, natural glow. If you are going to try this, and if you want to learn how to take care of yourself, not just on the outside, but from the root, to calm what is aging you from within, and let your body and your face reflect the peace you deserve to feel. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that, and everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
